input: receiver has n entries with 1 <= n <= 100000 and each entry in [0,n-1]. k is an integer in [1,10000000000]. Self-receivers and duplicate receivers are allowed. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Maximum over starting players of the sum of the starting index and the next k receiver indices, counting repetitions.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Level j records the endpoint and receiver-only sum of exactly 2^j passes. Scores are bounded by (k+1)*(n-1) < 10^15 and exact in Number. Repeated division/modulo, never 32-bit bitwise operations, reads every bit of k. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n*log(k+1)) time and O(n*log(k+1)) auxiliary storage, charging every jump/sum layer, initial receiver copies and all start evaluations. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1134 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. Mandatory isolated judging remains blocked; private original source/case/receipt material is unavailable. Static syntax/metadata checks do not establish correctness. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover one player, self loops, cycles, merging paths, repeated receivers, k above 2^32, inclusion of starting index and exact score bound, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
